pre_condition: state is a populated State instance. state.totals is a dict mapping token-category keys (including "cache_read", "input", "cache_write") to non-negative integer values. state.opencode_token_totals is a dict mapping the same token-category keys to non-negative integer values. state.cache_window is a list of (cache_read_count, total_count) tuples. state.model_seen is a model identifier string (may be empty). state.cost_native and state.opencode_cost are non-negative numeric cost values.
post_condition: Returns a Rich Panel renderable titled "Cache Coverage" with green border. When the sum of cache_read and input tokens (aggregated across both verification-LLM and OpenCode categories) equals zero, the panel contains centered dimmed text "(no token data yet)". Otherwise the panel contains text with: (a) three cache-coverage bar lines labeled "latest 10", "latest 100", and "overall", each displaying a percentage value color-coded by threshold (green when ≥ 80%, yellow when ≥ 50%, red otherwise), a 20-character visual bar where the filled proportion ("█") equals the percentage and the remainder is "░", and a dimmed token-count breakdown showing cache_read tokens over total tokens; (b) a dimmed line stating the coverage formula; and (c) when pricing data for the model is available via state.model_seen and total cache_read tokens exceed zero, a cost-savings line showing the estimated USD amount saved by cache reads and the percentage reduction versus a no-cache baseline. The state argument is not mutated by this call.
